Overview

The National Helpline for Senior Citizens is a 24-hour toll free service providing information, guidance, and emergency support to elderly persons in India. Operated under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, the helpline connects senior citizens with services related to pension, healthcare, legal aid, and protection from abuse. It is a key support line for elderly persons facing difficulties.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all senior citizens in India
  • Family members and caregivers can also call for guidance
  • The service is free and available round the clock

Benefits

  • Immediate assistance for elderly persons in distress
  • Information on pension, healthcare, and welfare schemes
  • Referral to legal, medical, and social services
  • Counselling and emotional support over the phone

How to Apply

  1. Dial the national helpline number from any phone
  2. Explain the query or situation to the counsellor
  3. Receive the required information and follow-up support

Required Documents

  • No documents are required to call the helpline
meta_title: National Helpline for Senior Citizens: 24-Hour Support
meta_description: The National Helpline for Senior Citizens provides round-the-clock information, counselling, and emergency support for the elderly. Learn more.

content:
Overview

The Gateway for Elderly Portal is a dedicated online platform of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for senior citizens in India. The portal provides information on schemes, welfare programmes, and services for the elderly, along with access to the Elder Line helpline. It serves as a single point of access for elderly welfare services and citizen engagement.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all senior citizens and their families in India
  • Registration on the portal is free
  • Information covers central and state schemes for the elderly

Benefits

  • Information on pension, healthcare, and welfare schemes for seniors
  • Access to the Elder Line helpline services
  • Facility to register complaints and seek support
  • News and updates on elderly welfare programmes

How to Apply

  1. Visit the Gateway for Elderly portal
  2. Register with basic details for personalised services
  3. Explore the schemes and services available

Required Documents

  • Mobile number and basic identity details for registration
meta_title: Gateway for Elderly Portal: Senior Citizen Services Online
meta_description: The Gateway for Elderly portal provides senior citizens with scheme information, Elder Line access, and online support services. Learn more.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Gramin Plus is a housing scheme for rural households in India, providing financial assistance for the construction of pucca houses. Under the scheme, eligible rural families receive up to Rs 1.2 lakh for house construction, along with support for toilets, electricity, and clean cooking fuel through convergence. It is implemented through the Awaas+ survey and the PMAY-G framework.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Rural households without a pucca house
  • Identification through the Awaas+ survey and SECC data
  • Priority for scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, and women headed households
  • Excluded categories as per the scheme's exclusion criteria

Benefits

  • Financial assistance of up to Rs 1.2 lakh for house construction
  • Additional support through convergence for toilets and utilities
  • Assistance for disabled persons under the scheme
  • Transparent disbursal in instalments linked to construction progress

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the gram panchayat or the PMAY-G portal
  2. Submit the application with beneficiary details
  3. Complete the verification and selection process
  4. Construct the house and receive the instalments on verification

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Land ownership documents
  • Category certificates, if applicable
meta_title: PMAY Gramin Plus: Rs 1.2 Lakh Rural Housing Assistance
meta_description: PMAY-G Plus provides up to Rs 1.2 lakh for pucca house construction to eligible rural households. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban 2.0 is the flagship housing scheme for urban areas, providing financial assistance to eligible urban households for the construction or purchase of houses. The scheme targets all eligible families in urban areas, with a focus on the urban poor and middle income groups. Assistance includes interest subsidy on housing loans and direct support for house construction.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Urban households belonging to EWS, LIG, and MIG categories
  • Families without a pucca house anywhere in India
  • Income criteria as per the scheme's category definitions
  • Exclusion criteria apply as per the scheme guidelines

Benefits

  • Financial assistance for house construction or purchase in urban areas
  • Interest subsidy on housing loans for eligible categories
  • Support for beneficiaries through state urban development agencies
  • Affordable housing projects under the scheme's verticals

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the PMAY-U portal or the urban local body
  2. Submit beneficiary details and category documents
  3. Complete the verification and selection process
  4. Avail the assistance through the designated channel

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
  • Income certificate
  • Property or land documents, where applicable
meta_title: PMAY Urban 2.0: Housing Assistance for Urban Families
meta_description: PMAY Urban 2.0 provides financial assistance and interest subsidies for houses to eligible urban households. Check eligibility and apply.

content:
Overview

Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 Urban focuses on sustaining and strengthening cleanliness and waste management in urban India. The mission component addresses solid waste management, faecal sludge management, and the processing of construction and demolition waste in cities. It also promotes source segregation of waste and the reduction of plastic waste through community participation.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all urban households and residents
  • Urban local bodies implement the mission's projects
  • No income or category restrictions apply

Benefits

  • Improved solid waste collection and processing in cities
  • Cleaner public spaces and better waste segregation
  • Support for recycling and waste to wealth initiatives
  • Public awareness campaigns on cleanliness and hygiene

How to Apply

  1. Citizens participate through cleanliness drives and the Swachhata app
  2. Report cleanliness issues to the urban local body
  3. Local bodies implement the mission projects as per the city plan

Required Documents

  • No documents are required for general participation
meta_title: SBM 2.0 Urban: Clean Cities & Waste Management
meta_description: Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 Urban improves solid waste management, faecal sludge processing, and cleanliness in Indian cities. Learn more.

content:
Overview

The AMRUT 2.0 Water Supply component focuses on ensuring universal water supply in urban areas of India. Under this component, cities implement projects for the augmentation of water sources, distribution networks, and household tap connections. The mission prioritises water scarce cities and the sustainable management of urban water resources.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Households in AMRUT 2.0 mission cities are eligible
  • Priority for cities with water scarcity and gaps in coverage
  • No income criteria for household connections

Benefits

  • Tap water connections for every household in mission cities
  • Improved water supply infrastructure and reliability
  • Water source augmentation and recharge initiatives
  • Reduced dependence on tanker and private water supply

How to Apply

  1. Apply for a new water connection through the urban local body
  2. Pay the connection charges as per the city's tariff
  3. Receive the tap connection after the infrastructure is laid

Required Documents

  • Property documents
  • Identity and address proof
meta_title: AMRUT 2.0 Water Supply: Tap Water for Urban Households
meta_description: AMRUT 2.0's water supply component provides household tap connections in mission cities. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

The Light House Initiative is a project of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs for the construction of affordable houses using new and innovative construction technologies. Under the initiative, light house projects demonstrate alternative building materials and fast, cost effective construction methods. The houses are built for urban beneficiaries under the PMAY-U framework, with sites in six states across India.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Beneficiaries are selected under the PMAY-U eligibility criteria
  • Houses are allotted to eligible urban households in the project cities
  • Category eligibility follows the EWS and LIG income norms

Benefits

  • Affordable houses built with modern construction technology
  • Faster construction and reduced project cost
  • Demonstration of sustainable building practices
  • Better quality and durability of housing

How to Apply

  1. Beneficiaries apply through the PMAY-U portal
  2. Selection follows the scheme's verification process
  3. Houses are allotted through the city's affordable housing process

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and income certificate
  • As per the PMAY-U application requirements
meta_title: Light House Initiative: Affordable Houses with New Technology
meta_description: The Light House Initiative builds affordable houses using innovative construction technologies in six states. Learn about the project.

Overview

The Heritage City Development and Augmentation Yojana (HRIDAY) is a scheme for the development of heritage cities in India. The scheme focuses on the preservation of heritage sites, improvement of urban infrastructure, and promotion of tourism in selected heritage cities. It integrates heritage conservation with city development to boost local economies and preserve cultural identity.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The scheme covers selected heritage cities identified by the government
  • Projects are implemented by the city development authorities
  • Benefits flow to residents, businesses, and tourists in the cities

Benefits

  • Restoration and preservation of heritage structures
  • Improved infrastructure around heritage sites
  • Enhanced tourism and local economic activity
  • Public amenities and beautification in heritage areas

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the scheme
  2. Citizens and businesses participate through the city's development process

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_description: HRIDAY develops heritage cities by preserving monuments, improving infrastructure, and boosting tourism. Learn about the scheme.

Overview

The National Urban Health Mission (NUHM) is a component of the National Health Mission that addresses the health needs of the urban poor. The mission establishes urban primary health centres, community health centres, and mobile health units in cities to provide accessible healthcare. It focuses on slum populations and vulnerable groups with outreach and referral services.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Urban residents, with priority for slum dwellers and the urban poor
  • Services are available at NUHM health facilities in cities
  • No income or category restrictions at the point of service

Benefits

  • Urban primary health centres providing basic healthcare
  • Maternal and child health services in urban areas
  • Mobile health units reaching underserved slums
  • Referral and follow-up support for specialised care

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest urban primary health centre
  2. Register as a patient and avail the consultation services
  3. Follow the referral process for specialised treatment

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card or any government-issued identity proof
meta_title: National Urban Health Mission: Healthcare for Urban Poor
meta_description: NUHM provides primary healthcare, maternal services, and mobile health units for urban poor and slum populations. Learn about the mission.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) is a national initiative for assured antenatal care for pregnant women in India. Under the programme, free antenatal check-ups are provided on the 9th of every month at government health facilities, conducted by obstetricians and trained doctors. The programme detects high risk pregnancies early and ensures timely referral and management.

Eligibility Criteria

  • All pregnant women in India are eligible for the free check-ups
  • Priority for first-time mothers and high risk pregnancies
  • Services are provided at designated PMSMA health facilities

Benefits

  • Free comprehensive antenatal check-up on the 9th of every month
  • Early detection of high risk pregnancy conditions
  • Free investigations and iron folic acid supplementation
  • Referral and follow-up for complicated pregnancies

How to Apply

  1. Visit the designated health facility on the 9th of the month
  2. Register the pregnancy and undergo the examination
  3. Receive the treatment and follow-up as advised

Required Documents

  • Pregnancy registration card
  • Aadhaar card or any government-issued identity proof
meta_title: PM Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan: Free Antenatal Check-ups
meta_description: PMSMA provides free antenatal check-ups for pregnant women on the 9th of every month at government facilities. Check eligibility.

Overview

The National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) is a programme to make one person in every eligible household digitally literate. The mission provides basic digital literacy training covering computers, smartphones, digital payments, and internet use. It is implemented through training centres with certified courses and assessments, supporting digital inclusion across India.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to citizens across India, with priority for rural and underserved areas
  • One person per eligible household can be trained
  • Age and qualification criteria as per the programme guidelines

Benefits

  • Free digital literacy training and certification
  • Hands-on skills in computers, internet, and digital payments
  • Better access to e-governance and online services
  • Foundation for digital employment opportunities

How to Apply

  1. Enrol at the nearest NDLM training centre or Common Service Centre
  2. Complete the training programme and the assessment
  3. Receive the digital literacy certificate

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Bank account details for incentive, where applicable
meta_title: National Digital Literacy Mission: Digital Training for All
meta_description: NDLM provides free digital literacy training covering computers, internet, and digital payments with certification. Check eligibility and enrol.

content:
Overview

PM eVIDYA is a comprehensive initiative of the Ministry of Education that unifies digital and online education efforts in India. The initiative provides multi-mode access to education through DIKSHA, one nation one digital platform, TV channels, radio programmes, and online courses for students across school and higher education levels. It ensures learning continuity for students through multiple digital channels.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all students from school to higher education levels
  • Access is free through the designated platforms and channels
  • Content is available in multiple Indian languages

Benefits

  • Access to e-content and digital courses on DIKSHA and other platforms
  • Dedicated TV channels for curriculum based learning
  • Radio programmes and podcasts for audio-based learning
  • Online resources for teachers and students across languages

How to Apply

  1. Access the DIKSHA portal or the PM eVIDYA app
  2. Select the class and subject to view the content
  3. No registration is required for most content

Required Documents

  • No documents are required for general access
meta_title: PM eVIDYA: Digital Education for Every Student
meta_description: PM eVIDYA provides digital education through DIKSHA, TV channels, and radio in multiple languages for students across India. Learn more.

content:
Overview

PM SHRI (PM Schools for Rising India) is a central scheme for the upgradation of more than 14,500 schools across India, including Kendriya Vidyalayas and Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas. The scheme develops model schools with modern infrastructure, smart classrooms, and experiential learning facilities. PM SHRI schools showcase the implementation of the National Education Policy and serve as exemplar institutions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Schools are selected through a transparent process by state and central agencies
  • PM SHRI schools admit students through the existing admission process of KVs and JNVs
  • Priority is given to students from the surrounding community

Benefits

  • Modern infrastructure with smart classrooms and labs
  • Experiential and activity based learning under NEP
  • Digital learning resources and teacher training
  • Focus on holistic development and skill education

How to Apply

  1. Admission to PM SHRI schools follows the respective school's admission process
  2. Contact the KV or JNV for admission details
  3. Seats are filled as per the school's admission policy

Required Documents

  • As required by the school's admission process
meta_title: PM SHRI Schools: Upgraded KVs & JNVs Under NEP
meta_description: PM SHRI upgrades 14,500+ schools including Kendriya and Navodaya Vidyalayas with modern infrastructure and NEP-based learning. Learn more.
